newsitem.title: ITALY: TABLE-New Holland Q2 '97 EPS rises on Q1 '96.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-New Holland Q2 '97 EPS rises on Q1 '96.

text.p: Note - Agricultural and construction equipment maker New Holland NV, part of Italy's Fiat group, said in a statement it expected favourable economic fundamentals seen in the first half of the year to remain in place throughout 1997.

In western Europe it expected a modest decline in industry sales of agricultural tractors, particularly in France and the U.K., while in north America it expected tractor demand to remain above 1996 levels.
Increase in tractor industry demand in Brazil and other Latin American countries was also expected to continue through the year while the Asia/Pacific area was expected to be down for the year.
